name: tree-sitter-hlsl
description: Fork of tree-sitter-hlsl@0.2.0 (tree-sitter-grammars) + struct-body macro-member patch for Unity CGIncludes

scripts.install: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('src/parser.c')){cp.execSync('node-gyp rebuild',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{console.log('[hlsl] src/parser.c 未生成（生成物不入库），跳过原生编译——先 npm run generate 再 compile/prebuild')}"
